experience.title: Customer Success Manager
facts: Owns onboarding, adoption planning, and quarterly business reviews for a portfolio of mid-market software customers.
Uses Salesforce to track account health, renewal risks, product feedback, and customer action plans.
Partners with support and product teams to resolve escalations and communicate product-release changes.
Improved onboarding completion by standardizing training checklists and customer enablement sessions.

experience.title: Implementation Specialist
facts: Coordinated SaaS implementations, customer data migrations, training sessions, and go-live readiness.
Managed project plans, customer stakeholders, issue logs, and post-launch handoffs to support.
Configured CSV and SFTP-based data imports with customer technical contacts.
